title: cocoon Wartime Anime Streams English-Dubbed Trailer
content: GKIDS began streaming on Tuesday an English-dubbed trailer for cocoon – One Summer of Girlhood ( cocoon Aru Natsu no Shōjo-tachi Yori ), the anime of Machiko Kyō 's Cocoon manga. This year's JAPAN CUTS event screened the anime's North American premiere on July 10.
author: ANN

title: Cells at Work! Gets Kabuki Stage Play in April 2027
content: A new official X/Twitter account opened last Friday to announce that Akane Shimizu 's Cells at Work! ( Hataraku Saibō ) manga is getting a kabuki stage play adaptation at the Shinbashi Enbujō in Tokyo in April 2027.
author: ANN

title: Kingdom Hearts 'Anime' Announced for Disney+, Kingdom Hearts IV Game Launches in Late 2027 Including Coco World
content: The D23 event's "Disney Entertainment Showcase" panel announced on Friday that an "anime" with the working title Kingdom Hearts based on Square Enix 's game franchise is in development for release on Disney+ and The Disney Channel . The event did not reveal what studio is producing the series.
author: ANN

title: Haikyu!! Movie 2 and Special Fukurodani vs Mujinazaka Anime to Reveal New Information on August 19
content: New information for Haikyu the Movie: VS The Little Giant (Movie 2) and the upcoming special anime Haikyu!! Where the Monsters Go ( Fukurodani vs Mujinazaka ) will be revealed on August 19. The announcements will be made during the third Haikyu!!

title: Re:ZERO Season 4 Episode 13 Preview Trailer and Images Revealed
content: Re:ZERO -Starting Life in Another World- Season 4 has revealed the Episode 13 (Episode 79 overall) preview ahead of its August 19, 2026 premiere. This will be the second episode of the second cour, which subtitled The Recapture Arc . A teaser trailer previously featured some of the scenes featured today as well.
author: Anime Corner

title: Takopi's Original Sin Movie Special Trailer Reveals November 27 Premiere
content: Takopi’s Original Sin -Thank You, See You Tomorrow- movie revealed a new trailer, as well as a November 27 premiere date for Japan. The anime originally ran from June 28 to August 1. It swept the weekly rankings every week during its run, taking five wins.
author: Anime Corner

title: 'Skip to Loafer 2nd Season' Reveals New Staff, Second Teaser Promo
content: • The official website for the Skip to Loafer 2nd Season ( Skip and Loafer Season 2 ) television anime revealed new staff and a second teaser promotional video on Sunday. The second anime season adapting Misaki Takamatsu 's coming-of-age manga will premier in April 2027.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Takopi's Original Sin Compilation Film's Video Unveils November 27 Debut
content: The official website for the anime of Taizan 5 's Takopi's Original Sin ( Takopii no Genzai ) manga began streaming a new "special video" for the anime's Takopii no Genzai -Arigatō, Mata Ashita- ( Takopi's Original Sin : Thank You, See You Tomorrow ) compilation film on Tuesday.
author: ANN
